name: panamericana
description: Sistema de gestion Panamericana: backend (API) + web (Next.js)

scripts.dev:backend: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace backend
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace web
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace backend && npm run build --workspace web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace backend && npm run lint --workspace web
